title: Timeline: add Convert to Keyframes and Reverse Frames operations
description: Two common Flash 8 timeline operations are missing from the right-click context menu: (1) 'Convert to Keyframes' — converts each frame in the selected span to an individual keyframe with a copy of the first keyframe's content; (2) 'Reverse Frames' — reverses the order of frames/keyframes in the selected range. Both should be in the right-click context menu when a multi-frame range is selected. Add them to Timeline.tsx context menu + handleContextAction, implement the model mutations in packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts.
